title: An exact Hausdorff gauge for SLE

abstractEnglish: For each $`0\lt \kappa\lt 8`$, we construct a deterministic Hausdorff gauge that almost surely assigns positive finite measure to every nontrivial compact positive-time segment of chordal Schramm–Loewner evolution. This answers Schramm's Hausdorff-measure existence problem in this parameter range. The entire trace has finite expected gauge measure in each bounded box.
